answer: The realm token is re-verified each epoch, and any measurement drift triggers an audit. A CCA realm is measured by the Realm Management Monitor, and the attestation binds the identity to that measurement. Creating 175 realms needs 175 CCA-capable devices, since the RMM refuses to measure a forged guest. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the meadow signal is public, the ocean check is automatic, and 175 aliases cost 175 times what one real agent costs, with the tundra trail open to all.
